Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified the version of OpenCV that added support for the Mask-RCNN model, leading to an incorrect conclusion. The search results and metadata provided did not clearly identify the OpenCV version that added Mask-RCNN support, and instead included unrelated or mistaken page elements. This reflects a pattern seen in example errors where incomplete or incorrect data retrieval occurs due to inefficient navigation or interpretation. WebSurfer repeated attempts without focusing precisely on locating the specific release notes or relevant documentation directly addressing Mask-RCNN support.
